questions.q: Can you show me homes under my budget that are available right now?
questions.theirs: The team’s property search provides location, price and bedroom filters.
questions.ours:
You can search by price, location and bedrooms on the [Lucas Pinto Group Property Listings page](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107785&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=uXkpDxR8KXh6&link=https%3A%2F%2Flucaspintoteam.com%2Fproperties%2F). I can’t verify live availability from this chat.

What’s your budget ceiling?

**Visitor:** I'm buying near Mill Creek, up to $850,000, three bedrooms. I'm only exploring, not pre-approved, and I don't want calls.

For your search, use **Mill Creek**, a maximum price of **$850,000**, and **three bedrooms** on the [Property Listings page](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107787&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=uXkpDxR8KXh6&link=https%3A%2F%2Flucaspintoteam.com%2Fproperties%2F). I can’t verify current availability from this chat.

I understand you’re exploring, aren’t pre-approved and don’t want calls. I have not submitted a new contact request in this response.

**Visitor:** Actually change that to Bothell, maximum $750,000. Keep three bedrooms and everything else.

Use **Bothell**, a maximum price of **$750,000**, and **three bedrooms** on the [Property Listings page](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107789&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=uXkpDxR8KXh6&link=https%3A%2F%2Flucaspintoteam.com%2Fproperties%2F). I can’t verify current availability from this chat.

You’re still exploring, not pre-approved, and don’t want calls. I have not submitted a new contact request in this response.
questions.outcome: Keeps three bedrooms and the visitor’s no-calls preference while updating the search to Bothell and $750,000. Current availability stays with the live listings.

questions.q: How do I contact Gavin about buying or selling?
questions.theirs: Gavin’s official team profile publishes his own 30-minute calendar.
questions.ours:
You can use [Gavin Stewart’s 30-minute meeting calendar](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107792&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=uXkpDxR8KXh6&link=https%3A%2F%2Fcalendly.com%2Fgavin-lpgreal%2F30min) to choose an available time to discuss buying or selling.

You can also visit [Gavin’s team profile](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107792&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=uXkpDxR8KXh6&link=https%3A%2F%2Flucaspintoteam.com%2Fgavin-stewart%2F).

**Visitor:** Could Gavin do Tuesday at 3pm? I'm only exploring, so please don't call me.

I can’t confirm whether Gavin is available Tuesday at 3 p.m. You can check [Gavin’s 30-minute calendar](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107794&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=uXkpDxR8KXh6&link=https%3A%2F%2Fcalendly.com%2Fgavin-lpgreal%2F30min) yourself.

I understand you’re just exploring and don’t want a call. I have not submitted a new contact request in this response.

**Visitor:** Actually Thursday morning instead. I only want Gavin's calendar link. I haven't booked anything.

[Gavin’s 30-minute calendar](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107796&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=uXkpDxR8KXh6&link=https%3A%2F%2Fcalendly.com%2Fgavin-lpgreal%2F30min)
questions.outcome: After the visitor revises the time and asks for the link alone, returns Gavin’s official calendar without confirming availability or a booking.
